About Essensuals Thailavaram

Where Style Meets Personalised Care

Located on GST Road in Thailavaram near SRM Nagar and Potheri, Essensuals by Toni&Guy provides professional hairdressing and grooming services designed to bring out your best self.

Whether you are looking for a sharp modern fade, a complete hair colour transformation, nourishing hair spa treatments, or precise beard grooming, our patient stylists take time to understand your unique face shape, hair type, and desired look through one-on-one consultation.

  • ✓ Personalised Consultation
  • ✓ Modern Styling & Cuts
  • ✓ Clean & Welcoming Ambience
  • ✓ Patient & Attentive Stylists
